experiment: EX-SCALE (scalability stress via jittered real-sensor replication)
honest_note: N>228 are jittered DUPLICATES of real PeMSD7-M sensors (scalability stress only; NOT new real data).

interpretation.runtime_claim: VALID -- train time grows super-linearly with N (exact k-NN is O(N^2)), motivating approximate k-NN for thousands of nodes. This is the usable result.
interpretation.coverage_claim: NOT a clean test -- naive node duplication BREAKS calibration/test exchangeability: near-identical duplicate sensors give correlated, lower-variance calibration residuals than the structurally-distinct held-out points, so the quantile is too tight and coverage under-covers at N>228 (0.90 at N=228 -> ~0.81 at N=456). Verified NOT an under-training artifact (N=456 still 0.808 at 20 epochs vs 8). The real multi-domain coverage evidence remains exp_multidomain_real.json (228 real traffic sensors, 0.919). Do NOT cite the N>228 coverage as a guarantee result.
